text:
The buyer is likely to prevail, so the answer is C. The custom-made shutters were screwed and bracketed into the window frames, so they were fixtures under the annexation, adaptation and intent test and passed with the home even though the sales agreement didn't mention them. I'm not adopting the team note: the man's removing the shutters and repairing the frames doesn't turn them back into personal property, because fixture status is fixed when the home is conveyed. The deed's covenants cover title, not fixtures, so D is wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 88
